==Problem 4==
When Yunji added all the integers from <imath>1</imath> to <imath>9</imath>, she mistakenly left out a number. Her incorrect sum turned out to be a square number. What number did Yunji leave out?

<imath>\textbf{(A) } 5\qquad\textbf{(B) } 6\qquad\textbf{(C) } 7\qquad\textbf{(D) } 8\qquad\textbf{(E) } 9</imath>

==Solution==
basically the one below i guess just explained a lil different. so yes we add <imath>1</imath> - <imath>9</imath> to get <imath>45</imath>. then we see what’s the closet square, which is obviously <imath>36</imath> (i hope we have our squares memorized by now) and then we do <imath>45</imath> minus <imath>36</imath> to get <imath>9</imath> 
<imath>\boxed{\textbf{(E)}\ 9}</imath>.
~pereena

Adding numbers 1 through 9 gives us 45. This was her expected sum, but what she got was a perfect square. Since she got that perfect square sum by forgetting a number, that sum is less than 45. The square number right under 45 is 36. So 45 - 36 = 9. So the solution is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(E)}\ 9}</imath>.

~That_One_Dude
